The '''Engira system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]. It contained the planet [[Engira]], which served as an Imperial supply colony. Convoys of supplies coming from Engira were directed to Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] and facilities throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], making the Engira system a prime target for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
